captions.caption: Dark storm clouds loom over a landscape in Denmark.
Lightning flashes behind thick clouds in Frederikshavn.
Intense lightning illuminates the heavy cloud cover.
A pinkish glow from lightning appears behind the dark clouds.
The sky is filled with dense, dark grey storm clouds.
A wide shot shows the stormy horizon over the town.
Low-hanging clouds stretch across the coastal horizon.
Dark clouds persist over the Frederikshavn area.
Heavy rain clouds gather over the sea and nearby land.
A dark storm continues to brew over the horizon.
The camera focuses on turbulent, low-hanging cloud formations.
Layered dark clouds move steadily across the sky.
A shelf cloud formation becomes visible against the dark sky.
The clouds look heavy and saturated with moisture.
The dark cloud base moves slowly across the frame.
Dense cloud cover indicates low atmospheric pressure.
A wall of clouds extends across the middle of the scene.
The lower edge of the clouds shows a jagged texture.
Deep, moody blue-grey clouds dominate the sky.
The storm system continues to develop over the water.
A bright lightning bolt strikes vertically toward the horizon.
Lightning illuminates the clouds with a distinct orange glow.
Massive, swirling storm clouds fill the entire view.
A large supercell cloud structure is visible in the distance.
Textured clouds in various shades of grey swirl overhead.
The powerful storm system appears imminent.
Internal lightning flashes briefly within the cloud mass.
The cloud base hangs extremely low to the ground.
Turbulent air movements create patterns in the clouds.
The sky brightens from internal lightning activity.
A dramatic view of the storm's core is shown.
Rain falls in the distance beneath the heavy clouds.
A massive shelf cloud looms over a sandy beach.
People on the beach observe the imposing shelf cloud.
The cloud has a smooth, well-defined leading edge.
A person runs across the sand as the storm nears.
The shelf cloud appears enormous compared to the people below.
Camper vans are parked along the beach under the dark sky.
The dark, menacing underside of the shelf cloud is visible.
The camera pans to reveal more of the beach area.
Gathered onlookers watch the approaching weather phenomenon.
Sea waves crash on the shore under the dark clouds.
The shelf cloud stretches as far as the eye can see.
Dark lighting creates a somber atmosphere on the beach.
Stormy clouds gather over a residential backyard with trees.
Dark clouds hang heavily above the green trees.
A white tent stands in the backyard under the storm.
Wind begins to rustle the branches of the trees.
The sky shows contrasting shades of grey and white.
Turbulent clouds swirl directly above the residential area.
The storm seems to be positioned right overhead.
Trees sway more strongly as the storm's edge arrives.
The camera pans across the yard as the sky darkens.
Rain begins to fall against the dark backdrop.
A white structure in the yard is buffeted by wind.
Raindrops begin to cover a glass window pane.
Large drops of rain strike the surface of the glass.
The outside view is blurred by heavy rain and water.
Intense rain continues to pelt the window window.
Water streaks down the glass during the heavy downpour.
